description.text: Core courses Principle of Education, General Psychology, History of Chinese Education, History of Education in Foreign Countries, Teaching Methodology, Principle of Moral Education, Child Psychology, Pedagogic Psychology, Human Anatomy and Physiology, Philosophy of Education, Educational Statistics and Its Application, Educational and Psychological Measurement, Methods of Education Research, Educational Law, Health Education to Students in Primary Schools, Learning Psychological Guidance to Primary School Students, Teaching Methodology of Primary School Subjects. Objective This objective is to train students to be key teachers in primary schools, who obtain good moral characters, solid pedagogic theory and systematic professional knowledge of all subjects taught in primary schools. After graduation, students will be able to work in the fields of education in mental health, educational affairs management, class-affairs management, Young Pioneers-affairs management as well as teaching and research-oriented work in schools that teach students who are on compulsory education stage. Meanwhile, students are trained to lay for solid foundation for further advanced studies in Principles of Education, Curriculum and Teaching Methodology, Comparative Education, Foundational Education, etc. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education is granted

duration.text: The Primary Education at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
